detailed_descriptions.en: Down with the Ship is a strategic auto‑battler about assembling your own hull, stuffing it with powerful hardware, and sending it to war against other players. Build Your Ship Connect hull pieces to expand your ship and make room for modules. Each round offers a new set of parts: guns, reactors, shields, cursed relics, and more. Buy what fits, lock what you need, and learn when a cheap common beats a flashy rare. Optimize the Design Positioning is the core of the game. Move parts around to manage resources, connect item effects, and stack bonuses. Build something reliable, or commit to one risky combo and hope it fires first. Take It to Battle Battles play out automatically, but you decide when your ship is ready to fight. Your current build is matched against stored ships from other players. Win, adapt, and keep going until your run breaks apart. Choose a Captain Each captain changes how you play, with different hull shapes, passives, and build paths. Lean into their faction’s tools, or mix in parts from other factions to make something less predictable. Game Modes Ranked Versus: Face player-made ships and push for 10 wins before your lives are spent. Climb the leaderboard with every successful run. Casual Versus: Test builds against player-made ships without worrying about rank. Endless Run: Hit 10 wins? Keep going until your ship loses 5 lives.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《與艦同沉》是一款策略自走棋，核心在於組建自己的船體、塞滿強大的硬體，並派它與其他玩家開戰。 打造你的船艦 連接船體零件來擴張船艦，替模組騰出空間。每回合都會提供一批新的零件：槍枝、反應爐、護盾、詛咒遺物等等。買下合適的、鎖定需要的，並學會判斷便宜的普通零件何時能勝過華而不實的稀有品。 最佳化設計 擺放位置是遊戲的核心。移動零件來管理資源、連接道具效果並疊加加成。打造可靠的配置，或是押注一套高風險連擊，祈禱它能先一步開火。 投入戰鬥 戰鬥會自動進行，但由你決定船艦何時準備好開戰。你目前的配置會與其他玩家儲存的船艦配對。取勝、調整，然後繼續前進，直到這次遊玩分崩離析。 選擇船長 每位船長都會以不同的船體形狀、被動能力與構築路線改變你的玩法。善用其勢力的工具，或混入其他勢力的零件，打造更難預測的東西。 遊戲模式 排名對戰： 面對玩家打造的船艦，在生命耗盡前衝擊 10 場勝利。每次成功遊玩都能讓你在排行榜上更進一步。 休閒對戰： 不必擔心排名，對抗玩家打造的船艦來測試配置。 無盡遊玩： 已經達成 10 場勝利？繼續戰鬥，直到你的船艦失去 5 條生命。
